title: After Destruction of the One Ring, Mordor Announces Major Reduction In Workforce
subtitle: Sauron, noted Maia, steps down from the board of directors.
text:
MORDOR, Middle-earth, Aug. 15, The Fourth Age/PRNewswire/ –

Mordor, a dominion known for its influence in Middle-earth, today announced a major reorganization to align with its vision following the exit of its founder, Sauron.

"Mordor is deeply dedicated to bringing more options—for more suffering— to those suffering from our proprietary inflicted-PTSD. We remain highly committed to this goal," said Gothmog, newly appointed Chief Executive Officer of Mordor. "At the same time, we take to heart the fires of mount doom’s ability to melt the One Ring. This makes it clear we need to do the additional work to bring this pioneering rings-and-suffering approach to market."

“Mordor has always been a dominant force in Middle-earth, and we remain committed to maintaining our position,” he added, continuing,“At the same time, we acknowledge the need to evolve and adapt, and Sauron’s departure is part of our strategy to move Mordor forward into a new era, in which we can exert iron-fisted control, with or without rings on those fists.”

After the destruction of the One Ring prototype, as a result of regrettable corporate security breech on the part of former ring-bearers Sméagol “Gollum” McDonald and Frodo Baggins, secondary market valuations of shares of the large—but private— company tumbled by over 70%. Prior employees, such as G. Wormtongue, highlight disappointment, “our One Ring platform solution was promising, but the market has moved on.”

As part of this reorganization, the Dark Tower will now be overseen by the SVP of the Nazgûl, The Witch-king of Angmar. Mr. of Angmar will manage Mordor’s operations, focusing on strategic growth and stability. The Nazgûl, having served under Sauron for many years, bring a wealth of wraith-experience and a deep understanding of Mordor’s objectives and will be instrumental through this transition.

“My vision is to build on the strong foundation that Sauron established while steering Mordor towards a more trauma and precious-informed suffering solutions,” said the Witch-king. “We have the opportunity to reimagine Mordor’s role in Middle-earth, and I am eager to walk in darkness, neither dead nor alive, into this promising and transformative future for the company.”

“Gothmog and the new, lean “best of Nazgûl” team are well-suited to take Mordor into its next chapter of unimaginable horror for all who oppose us,” added the Mouth of Sauron, who remains a member of the executive leadership team. “Their leadership, combined with their deep-rooted knowledge of the darkness, ensures that Mordor will continue to corrupt all it touches, and expand our influence across Middle-earth, in our now more capital efficient organization. What once required nine dark riders? We now see those tasks as tech-enabled opportunities for teams of as few as one, powered by our new Wraith-AI.”

In addition to leadership changes, Mordor will be realigning its forces, with a significant reduction in the Orc workforce by approximately 75%. The Nazgûl will be reduced to 3 full time equivalent roles. The remaining forces will concentrate on fortifying key strongholds, securing strategic alliances across Middle-earth, and building their new WaaS platform infrastructure team, which will focus on novel prompt engineering for more efficient dominion management.”

“The Orcs have been the backbone of Mordor’s might, and we sincerely appreciate their dedication,” said Gothmog. “As we move forward, our focus will be on right-sizing to ensure Mordor remains a less-assailable power in Middle-earth.”

However, even the leadership team dark will be run absent one familiar, if menacing, role: Sauron has officially stepped down from his role as Lord of Mordor.

“...”

No sound of any kind escaped from Sauron, as his giant lidless eye searched, endlessly, for a new role.

"Sauron has been a trailblazing pioneer in this field," said Mr. of Angmar. "His many decades of leadership, unparalleled dedication, and deep contributions have shaped and guided the revival of One Ring research and development, spurring transformative innovation in dominion over other rings. His legacy will continue through the work of both Mordor and its peers as we all work towards providing new and better ring-management options for millions of middle-earth denizens in need dominion."

This reorganization marks a new beginning for Mordor, with a renewed focus on strategic growth, innovation, and the expansion of its ability to remove all hope throughout Middle-earth.

About Mordor

Mordor, located in the southeast of Middle-earth, has been a dominant force in ring-tech. Known for its formidable military strength and strategic importance, Mordor has played a key role in shaping the history of Middle-earth. With a renewed focus on leadership, strategy, and innovation, Mordor is poised to continue its influence across the realms, now powered by AI.

For more information, visit www.mordor.pom and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook
